title: Why Do Fingers Wrinkle in Water?
subject: Biology
objective: Skin soaking up water is not the full story: a finger with nerve damage stays smooth. How the nervous system makes wrinkles, and why their purpose is still debated.

fill.q: Fingers with ____ damage do not wrinkle normally.
Wrinkling is controlled by the ____ system.
The fingertip's ____ falls, and the skin is pulled into folds.
The grip benefit found in 2013 was not repeated in ____.

tf.q: Wrinkling is only water soaking into the skin.
Doctors can use wrinkling to check nerve function.
tf.explain: It is a simple bedside test.

tf.q: The purpose of wrinkles is proven.
The 2013 study found no benefit for dry objects.
tf.explain: The difference was only for wet objects.

ar.a: Wrinkling is not just water absorption.
ar.r: Fingers with nerve damage do not wrinkle normally.

mcq.explain: Nerves are the cause; the purpose is open.

short.q: Write the steps of wrinkling in order.
short.solution: Nerve signal, blood vessels narrow, fingertip volume falls, skin is pulled into wrinkles.

short.q: Why is the grip idea called a hypothesis?
short.solution: A 2013 study supported it, but a 2014 study could not repeat the result.
